title: Career Roadmap · Yoga Instructor
summary: A Yoga Instructor teaches yoga postures, breathing techniques, relaxation and safe practice to support flexibility, mobility, balance and general wellbeing.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 12 → Yoga diploma / recognized certificate or relevant degree → Practical teaching experience → Yoga Instructor → Advanced specialization.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream may be suitable; check the course’s entry criteria.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Physical Education, Biology, Psychology and Health Education, where available.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Yoga asanas, basic anatomy, breathing techniques, meditation and wellness.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Communication, body awareness, discipline, observation and safe demonstration.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Verify the current course eligibility and practical-training requirements.

items.text: Diploma in Yoga / Yoga Education → Entry-level instruction, subject to course recognition and employer requirements.
Certificate in Yoga → Introductory training; scope depends on the provider and qualification.
B.Sc. / B.A. in Yoga or Yoga Science → Broader study of yoga theory, practice and research, where offered.
Relevant postgraduate study → Advanced teaching, research or wellness specialization.

blocks.label: Certification route
blocks.text: The Ministry of AYUSH’s Yoga Certification Board (YCB) offers certification pathways for yoga professionals. Check the current examination scheme and eligibility before applying.

blocks.label: Eligibility
blocks.text: Depends on the scheme, course recognition, income, category, domicile and academic criteria.
No universal percentage cutoff applies. Verify current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Yoga philosophy, basic anatomy, asanas, pranayama and safe alignment.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Sequencing, teaching methods, modifications and supervised instruction.

blocks.label: Practice
blocks.text: Maintain a teaching log, plan sessions and learn to adapt practices for different abilities.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Beginner class plan; chair-yoga sequence; breathing and relaxation session; posture-safety guide.

blocks.label: Public / community
blocks.text: Community yoga programmes, educational institutions and wellness initiatives, where placements are available.

blocks.label: Private
blocks.text: Yoga studios, fitness centres, wellness retreats and corporate-wellness providers.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Beginner instruction, group-class assistance, adaptive yoga and session planning.
Opportunities depend on the organisation and its safety requirements; placements are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Certification route
Specialized route
blocks.text: Further study and experience → advanced yoga teaching, school instruction or eligible yoga-therapy training.
YCB offers different certification levels, including Yoga Protocol Instructor, Yoga Wellness Instructor, and Yoga Teacher & Evaluator. YCB conducts assessments; it does not itself provide jobs.
Yoga Certification Board

blocks.text: Common requirements

items.text: Course-specific academic prerequisites.
Prior yoga practice or experience for some advanced programmes.
Practical assessments and teaching demonstrations.
English or local-language proficiency where required.
Additional requirements for health-related or regulated occupations.

blocks.text: Yoga teacher training is not uniformly regulated internationally. Confirm accreditation, professional recognition and course requirements with the provider and relevant local body.

blocks.label: Typical route
Important
blocks.text: Some employers prefer credentials from recognized yoga organizations and documented teaching hours. Work authorization and visa sponsorship depend on the country and employer; neither is guaranteed.
Yoga Trainee ↓ Yoga Instructor ↓ Experienced Yoga Teacher ↓ Specialist / Wellness Instructor ↓ Lead Instructor / Trainer ↓ Studio Owner / Educator / Researcher

CLASS 12 ↓ YOGA DIPLOMA / RECOGNIZED TRAINING ↓ PRACTICE + ANATOMY + TEACHING SKILLS ↓ SUPERVISED TEACHING EXPERIENCE ↓ YOGA INSTRUCTOR ↓ YCB CERTIFICATION, IF APPROPRIATE ↓ SPECIALIZATION + EXPERIENCE ↓ LEAD INSTRUCTOR / WELLNESS SPECIALIST / ENTREPRENEUR
